# BEGIN duhoctesolhcmc.vn canonical host  (them 2026-09-18)
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On

# 1. KHONG dung vao xac thuc SSL - neu chan, AutoSSL se khong gia han duoc cert
RewriteRule ^\.well-known/ - [L]

# 1b. 4 trang nganh rong tu WP export (soft-404) -> trang nganh that  (them 2026-09-20)
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/cntt/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/cong-nghe/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/ky-thuat/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/cong-nghe/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/kinh-doanh/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/kinh-te/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^nganh-hoc/y-suc-khoe/?$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/nganh-hoc/suc-khoe/ [R=301,L]

# 2. Subdomain test cu -> domain chinh
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^duhoctesol\.duystudy\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]

# 3. Subdomain cPanel tu sinh khi tao addon domain -> domain chinh
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^duhoctesolhcmc\.vn\.amigoagency\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]

# 4. www -> non-www  (canonical trong trang la non-www)
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.duhoctesolhcmc\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]

# 5. http -> https cho domain chinh
RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^duhoctesolhcmc\.vn$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://duhoctesolhcmc.vn/$1 [R=301,L]
</IfModule>
# END duhoctesolhcmc.vn canonical host
